verdicts.reason: Both reverse the copy order to '$199 / New York / from', so 'from' dangles as an orphan after the destination, and in both the brand logo has dropped from the top of the hierarchy. A: the centre text stack is loosely spaced, 'from' is tiny, the suitcase is undersized against a lot of empty blue, and the logo is tucked under the Book button at the far right, but it is still legible. B: the suitcase is oversized and nearly touches the top and bottom edges, the Meridian logo has shrunk to an illegible sliver jammed beside the suitcase wheel, and the Book button floats on its own, so the brand is weaker than in A.
